snippet.title: AfterWar - Gameplay version 1.0
snippet.description:
AfterWar - Gameplay version 1.0

AfterWar is a simple yet feature-rich strategy game for everyone.
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

⚔️ Animated battles for every sector
🗺️ More than 25,000 sectors
🌍 Realistic geography of planet Earth
🎮 Multiplayer
🌐 191 languages
💻 Available on PC
📱 Available on Android

🎮 Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2497570/AfterWar/

📱 Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SKLGames.AfterWarRealTimeStrategy

📢 Site:
https://afterwargame.com/

The game was created by Dmytro Lumen (solo developer)r

TAGS: #game #strategy #afterwar
